annotations.title: Count the exact tokens in a text

description: Use when the user asks how many tokens a text, prompt, log, document or code paste is, whether it fits a context window (128K, 200K, 1M), or how big something is before they send it to an AI. Returns the exact o200k token count (GPT-4o family and later; Claude and Gemini usually within about 15%), plus words, characters and how much of each window it uses. Counts are exact for that tokenizer. Example: {"text": "<the text to measure>"}. Not for shortening text.

text.description: The text to count (up to 200,000 characters).

name: tokendiet_count_tokens
